judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the TDD planning/red-test phase and did not actually implement the fix. It only added `.lore/dod.md` and a new failing test file `src/orchestration/nonErrorRejection.acceptance.test.ts`. It never modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to wrap non-Error rejections and call `onError`, nor did it update `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` or `CHANGELOG.md`. Because the newly added acceptance tests fail against the untouched implementation, the test suite is left in a broken state.
